Slagelse refers to Slagelse Sygehus (Slagelse Hospital), a healthcare organization operating within Region Sjælland (Region Zealand) [^src1]. In the context of clinical databases and medical reporting, this designation specifically identifies the hospital, distinguishing it from the city of Slagelse or any other institutions that share the name [^src1].

As a reporting entity, Slagelse Sygehus contributes vital data to the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) [^src1]. The hospital's submissions are utilized in supplementary analyses of patient composition, specifically focusing on the distribution of cancer diseases among patients undergoing acute surgery [^src1]. This specific reporting period covers operations performed between September 1, 2022, and August 31, 2023 [^src1]. 

This data collection is part of a comprehensive quality development effort spearheaded by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Program [^src1]. The detailed, hospital-level distribution of cancer diagnoses provided by Slagelse Sygehus is essential for assessing Indicator 11, which measures 90-day mortality [^src1]. Because comorbidities like cancer are established predictors of postoperative outcomes, this granular data enables accurate risk adjustment of indicators and supports the broader evaluation of surgical quality measures [^src1].
